Greetings, Agents. 


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The creature who aims to evolve to a different level 
has found the answer after encountering the Guardians of the Galaxy team

 

Adam Warlock will show the powers of a cosmic being 
with his new Uniform and Tier-4.

 

Agents, check out his new skills and power
by downloading the 5/30 Patch!

 

[5/31 (Wed) 3:01 (UTC+0), 5/30 (Tue) 20:01 (PDT) added]

The Patch is currently being delayed.

We apologize for the inconvenience and will make further announcements

when the Patch has been completed through this notice.

 

■ 5/30 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 5/31 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 5/30 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 

5/31 (Wed) 3:30 (UTC+0), 5/30 (Tue) 20:30 (PDT) 

 

[5/31 (Wed) 3:25 (UTC+0), 5/30 (Tue) 20:25 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 5/31 (Wed) 3:19 (UTC+0), 5/30 (Tue) 20:19 (PDT). 

We apologize for the delay with the patch application.

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
Please restart and apply the patch for better service when the patch is complete.

 


▣ One New Uniform

 

One new Uniform, Adam Warlock <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3>, has been added.  
* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 5/16 Patch data is applied.
* The new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

  

 

 

▣ Adam Warlock Tier-4


Adam Warlock is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Check out the brilliant light that he emits.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the cool Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The highest score in Otherworld Battle has been increased from 4,500 to 5,500 points. 
 
2. The Otherworld Battle Challenger League point system has been adjusted. 

- Points earned and lost from victories or defeats have been adjusted for the distinction of our Agents.
- Points earned and lost from defense success or failure have been decreased compared to before. 

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The battle point being displayed to be decreased when winning a battle 
after the maximum score has been reached in Otherworld Battle has been fixed.


2. Taskmaster’s Tier-3 skill animation being repetitively exposed in specific situations has been fixed. 

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.

 

Thank you.
